description: Find rhymes for any word from a built-in bank of ~40 rhyme families, with a same-ending fallback matcher.

faqs.a: About 40 rhyme families (like -ay, -ight, -oon) with hundreds of words. It won't know every word in English — that is an honest limit of a built-in bank.
faqs.q: How many words does it know?

faqs.a: If your word matches no family, it finds bank words sharing the same last 2–3 letters.
faqs.q: What if my word has no rhymes?

faqs.a: Rhymes are grouped by family so you can scan endings quickly.

howto: Click any rhyme to copy it.
title: Rhyme Finder
